content: etcd v3 API (etcd.io docs v3.6/v3.7) exposes gRPC services: KV (Put/Range by key or prefix/Delete with MVCC revisions), Watch (stream changes on keys/prefixes from a revision), Lease (TTL keys with keep-alive), Cluster, Auth (RBAC users/roles/permissions), Maintenance (snapshot save/restore, defragment, hash). Compaction discards superseded versions/event history; watching compacted revisions errors. Linearizable reads by default; serializable (stale) reads optional. TLS/mTLS for client and peer traffic. etcdctl CLI for all operations.
